scope: One-step transfer verification by default, not full optimization convergence or a corpus-level LLM superiority claim. All 30 named TOY/MAJ entries retained. Existing prespecified June-then-Compact baseline selection is reused.
controls: Identical certified initial layout, menu generator/cap48, live candidate-slot budget, exact single routing-order attempt, <=8 coordinate edits, same clock/source/QCA certification and strict area/cell Pareto acceptance per case. Deterministic chooses first remaining menu entry; LLM chooses a recorded ID.
paired_ablations: Every valid LLM proposal replayed from the identical incumbent as placement-only and routing-only; these results do not affect live selection or feedback.
policy_order: Alternates per original ordinal. Cases execute independently in a bounded two-worker pool.
no_retries: Real model requests submitted at most once per case/policy/round; failures retained. No hidden routing-order fallback or new baseline selection.
input_caveats: Original TOY/RCA2 is tested exactly as supplied. Source equivalence does not imply correct two-bit arithmetic; the separately corrected v1 changes 12/32 vectors.
Original TOY/xor2 header is repaired by the existing frontend without changing logic; source and normalized hashes are both frozen.
30 representation cases contain 29 byte-unique sources and 16 fixed-port-order truth-table groups. Neither repeats nor equivalent encodings are independent new functions.
